snippet.title: moorestech - Automation Factory Sim | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! → https://store.steampowered.com/app/1958160

Transmit power through gears and build a massive factory!

As Princess Yori, exiled to an uninhabited planet, rebuild civilization from scratch. Join your companions on a journey to construct a rocket and return home.

moorestech is a fresh blend of factory automation simulation and anime-style RPG. Generate rotation with waterwheels, adjust speed and torque through gears, and power your machines and conveyor belts.
From windmills to steam engines, electricity, and nuclear fusion—experience humanity's technological evolution while building fully automated production lines.

#moorestech #Steam #AutomationGame #FactoryGame #IndieGame
